title: Sorting Recycling in an Apartment Building
context: 住户 Mei 向管理员 Carlos 询问这栋楼的回收标识，并按指示处理纸箱和塑料袋。 本课为 2026-11-22 预制系列原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: I just moved in. Could you explain the labels on these bins?
dialogue.zh: 我刚搬进来。你能解释一下这些桶上的标签吗？

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Sure. In this building, clean paper and cardboard go in the blue bin.
dialogue.zh: 当然。在这栋楼里，干净的纸和纸板放蓝桶。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: I have a large delivery box. Should I flatten it first?
dialogue.zh: 我有一个大快递箱。要先压扁吗？

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Yes, please. That leaves more room for other boxes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。这样能为其他纸箱腾出更多空间。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: What about the plastic bag inside the box?

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Our sign says not to put plastic bags in the blue bin.
dialogue.zh: 我们的标识说塑料袋不能放进蓝桶。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: Is there another collection point nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: The grocery store across the street has a bag collection box.
dialogue.zh: 街对面的杂货店有塑料袋收集箱。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: I will take the bag there when I go shopping.
dialogue.zh: 我购物时会把袋子带过去。

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Thanks. The green bin here is for bottles and cans.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。这里的绿桶是放瓶子和罐子的。

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.en: I see the picture on the lid now. I will check the signs next time.
dialogue.zh: 我现在看到盖子上的图了。下次我会查看标识。

dialogue.speaker: Carlos
dialogue.en: Good plan. Let me know if a label is hard to understand.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。如果有标签看不懂就告诉我。

expressions.example: Please flatten the box before storing it.
Moving the chair will leave more room.
There is a collection point near the entrance.
The pharmacy is across the street.
Check the sign before entering the room.

pronunciation: cardboard 重音在第一音节；bottles 的中间 t 在美音中常变成轻快的闪音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Recycling
practice.prompt: Do you sort your recycling at home?
practice.answer: Yes. I keep paper separate from bottles and check the labels on the bins when I am unsure.

practice.title: Part 2 · Learning a local rule
practice.prompt: Describe a time you learned how to sort waste somewhere. Say where you were, what you learned, and what you did.
practice.answer: When I moved into an apartment, I asked the building manager about the bins. He showed me that clean cardboard went in the blue bin and explained that I should flatten my boxes. The sign also said plastic bags did not belong there. I took my bag to a collection box at a nearby store. Reading the labels made the task much easier. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Clear instructions
practice.prompt: Why do recycling instructions need to be clear and local?
practice.answer: Collection systems can differ from place to place. Clear local signs help people put items in the right containers and reduce confusion.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读询问分类的对话，再就一个具体物品向管理员提问。
practice.answer: Where should I put this cardboard box? Should I flatten it first? I will check the sign for the plastic bag.
